headline: 'She is asleep, yet she eats': The patients who suffer from sleep-related eating disorders
description: 'Strange Nights' (7/7). Only upon waking do they realize they've consumed all sorts of things: cakes, cold canned goods, even laundry detergent. This highly specialized form of sleepwalking, which can cause psychological distress, remains poorly understood.

headline: Retro 'sunflower' pools bring nostalgia to Paris region and beyond
description: 'Aquatic Monuments' (5/6). The Tournesol pool, an emblem of prefabricated and modular architecture, spread throughout France in the 1970s, leaving its mark on generations of swimmers with its flying saucer-like appearance. Built in 1976, the Raymond-Mulinghausen pool in Les Lilas, on the edge of Paris, still welcomes swimmers in an almost unchanged setting.
